description: This is a test class for the Vacancy Data Access Object (VacancyDao) in the OrangeHRM Recruitment module. It includes unit tests for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and filtering vacancies, as well as testing specific retrieval methods like getting hiring manager lists and counting vacancies.
